subject: Request: Management bridge / post-report affirmation for SOC 2 period (Xenotech)
messages:
From: Alex Johnson <alex.j@xenotech.com>

Cc: security@xenotech.com
Date: 2027-04-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SOC 2 post-report affirmation request

Hi Kimberly,

Hope you’re well. We’re collecting attestation materials to complete our vendor risk review for Q2. Your SOC 2 Type II report (end date 2026-12-31) looks good, but our audit requires an affirmation that there have been no material changes to control environment since the report date through the present.

Can Redwood provide a management "bridge" letter (or similar post-report affirmation) covering 2027-01-01 through today (we'd like through 2027-04-15)? Ideally the document would:
- confirm no material changes to controls covered by the SOC 2 scope;
- note any known exceptions (if any);
- indicate whether the auditor can provide a signed extension/attestation or if Redwood will provide management attestation only.

Also let us know whether you can include a dated statement (we need the document dated within the last 7 days). If helpful, we can accept a management-signed letter for now and follow up if an auditor affirmation is available.

Thanks — we’re on a tight timeline for our quarterly vendor sign-off.

Best,
Alex

Hi Alex — thanks for the clear note and timeline. Looping in Rishi from our Compliance team; he’ll own the bridge letter content and sign-off cadence.

Quick answers:
- We can provide a management bridge letter dated within 7 days that affirms there have been no material changes to the control environment in scope aside from items already called out in the 2026 report (none).
- Our auditor (Brightfield LLP) has agreed in the past to provide a short professional letter on request, but that typically requires a separate engagement confirmation (they charge a small fee and need 3–5 business days). If you need auditor-signed affirmation, please let us know now; otherwise we’ll deliver management attestation first and escalate auditor confirmation in parallel.

Rishi — can you prepare a draft bridge letter for Xenotech covering 2027-01-01 through 2027-04-15? Alex asked for the letter to be dated within the last 7 days. I’ve attached the 2026 SOC 2 Type II report for reference.

1) Could the affirmation include a single-line statement confirming there have been no control failures that impacted our data in the period? (management attestation is fine)
2) Please date the letter 2027-04-15 and have it signed by the Head of Security.

We do not require Brightfield to sign for initial acceptance, so management attestation will be enough for our quarterly sign-off. If we later need auditor corroboration, we’ll reach back out.

If you can push the final PDF by COB tomorrow, we’ll mark this vendor as approved in our tracker.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.
